{{Short description|Norwegian microbiologist}}
'''Anne-Brit Kolstø''' (born 21 May 1945) is a Norwegian microbiologist.

She took her [[dr.philos.]] degree in biochemistry at the [[University of Tromsø]], and is now a professor of microbiology at the Department of Pharmaceutical Biosciences, University of Oslo. From 2002 to 2005 she served as [[prorector]] of the University of Oslo.<ref name=uio>{{cite web|url=http://www.mn.uio.no/farmasi/english/people/aca/annebko/|title=Anne-Brit Kolstø|publisher=[[University of Oslo]]|accessdate=18 May 2014}}</ref>

She is a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] and the [[Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters]].<ref name=uio/> She is also a deputy board member of the [[Norwegian University of Life Sciences]].<ref>{{cite press release|url=http://www.regjeringen.no/nb/dep/kd/pressesenter/pressemeldinger/2013/kunnskapsdepartementet-har-oppnevnt-nye-.html?id=747426|title=Kunnskapsdepartementet har oppnevnt nye styreledere og styremedlemmer|date=5 December 2013|publisher=[[Government.no]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=18 May 2014}}</ref>

She was married to fellow professor [[Hans Prydz (biochemist)|Hans Prydz]] (1933–2011).<ref>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Hans Prydz|encyclopedia=[[Norsk biografisk leksikon]]|first=Lars|last=Walløe|authorlink=Lars Walløe|editor=Helle, Knut|editor-link=Knut Helle|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=http://www.snl.no/.nbl_biografi/Hans_Prydz/utdypning|language=Norwegian|accessdate=18 May 2014}}</ref> They resided at [[Smestad, Oslo|Smestad]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Med genene godt plantet i jorden|last=Kleppe|first=Inger Lise|author2=Melgård, Ole Morten|work=VG|pages=28–29|language=Norwegian}}</ref>
